headline: Cincinnati knock out Orlando in MLS wild card; Daryl Dike hurt after coming on
facts: FC Cincinnati beat Orlando City 3-1 in the MLS playoff wild card; Martin Ojeda scored first for Orlando, then Evander and Samuel Gidi scored for Cincinnati.
Daryl Dike came on in the 75th minute and was hurt soon after; the interim coach suspected a hamstring problem, and Orlando had no subs left.
Orlando's season ended in Antoine Griezmann's first year at the club; Cincinnati now face Nashville SC in a best-of-three.
background: Dike has a long injury record: a season-ending hamstring injury in 2022 and Achilles ruptures in both legs in 2023 and 2024.
footage_terms: Orlando City vs FC Cincinnati wild card highlights

headline: Real Salt Lake beat Seattle on penalties as keeper Rafael Cabral is the hero
facts: The West wild card ended 1-1 after 90 minutes at Lumen Field, with Albert Rusnak scoring for Seattle and Morgan Guilavogui equalizing for RSL.
RSL won the shootout 4-2; keeper Rafael Cabral saved from Dejan Joveljic and Rusnak, and Philip Quinton scored the winning kick.
RSL, the No. 9 seed, now face No. 1 seed Vancouver Whitecaps in a best-of-three, even after losing their two best players during the season.
background: Seattle Sounders are one of MLS's most decorated clubs and have been regular playoff qualifiers, so an exit in the wild card round is a rare early end.
footage_terms: Real Salt Lake Seattle Sounders penalty shootout highlights
Rafael Cabral saves Seattle wild card

headline: Thomas Muller says MLS has no relegation fear and plays 'careless' style
facts: The 37-year-old Vancouver forward told Canadian outlet Global News that no promotion or relegation makes MLS defending less disciplined.
He said players face less pressure than in Europe, where bottom teams fight to survive, and that this hurts focus over 90 minutes.
He credited MLS with attractive attacking play and strong individual moments but said quality is less consistent.
background: Muller won the World Cup and Champions League with Bayern Munich and joined the Whitecaps in August 2025; he renewed his contract through next year.

headline: MLS Round 1 preview: Messi's Miami vs Columbus, Nashville the favorites
facts: The playoff field was cut to 16 after Orlando and Seattle went out in the wild card; Round 1 is best-of-three starting Saturday.
All four ESPN writers pick Inter Miami (No. 2) to beat Columbus Crew (No. 7); Robert Lewandowski's Chicago has slipped since the summer, and LAFC with Son Heung-min has underperformed.
Miami is playing with a largely new attacking group compared with the one that won MLS Cup a year ago.
background: Inter Miami won MLS Cup in 2025 with Messi, who was league MVP that year.
footage_terms: Inter Miami vs Columbus Crew playoffs highlights
Messi Inter Miami MLS Cup 2025 final

headline: ESPN reviews every eliminated MLS team: Orlando's leaky defense, Austin boycott, D.C. drought
facts: Orlando conceded 78 goals in the regular season, one of the worst defenses in league history, even though Antoine Griezmann scored 14 goals in 18 games after joining in July.
D.C. United missed the playoffs for a seventh straight year; Louis Munteanu did not justify his reported $7 million fee.
Breel Embolo scored four goals in 11 games for Atlanta; LA Galaxy lost Riqui Puig to a knee injury before his season started.
background: Griezmann moved to Orlando from Atletico Madrid in July 2026, where he was a long-time club icon and top scorer.

headline: Messi still MLS's top earner at $28.33 million; Cavan Sullivan at $614,000
facts: Messi's guaranteed compensation is $28.33 million, up from $20.45 million a year earlier, covering only the playing part of his pay.
Five MLS players now earn over $10 million: Messi, Lewandowski, Griezmann, Son Heung-min and Breel Embolo.
Philadelphia Union teenager Cavan Sullivan is listed at $614,000 guaranteed.
background: Messi joined Inter Miami in 2023 after leaving Paris Saint-Germain, and the league's pay scale was reshaped around such stars.

headline: FC Cincinnati near deal to buy Racing Louisville and move it to Cincinnati in 2028
facts: The two ownership groups are close to an agreement, but no deal is final and the price is unclear.
Racing would play 2027 in Louisville, then move about 100 miles to play at TQL Stadium from 2028.
Racing averaged just under 5,500 fans per game this year; recent expansion fees, like $205 million for Columbus, are far higher than Racing's roughly $2 million entry fee in 2021.
background: FC Cincinnati joined MLS in 2019 and has won the Supporters' Shield; NWSL expansion fees have soared in recent years.

headline: Nashville SC set MLS record with 77 points and win the Supporters' Shield
facts: Nashville set a single-season MLS points record with 77, passing Inter Miami's 74 from 2024.
ESPN ranks them No. 1 in its playoff power rankings; the club is the top seed in the East.
The strengths named are goalkeeper Brian Schwake, a deep defense with Defender of the Year candidates, and a strong attack.
background: Nashville joined MLS in 2020 and long had a reputation as a tough, low-budget side before this record season.

headline: Messi to play in Argentina with Inter Miami: River Plate friendly on Jan. 19
facts: Inter Miami will play River Plate at Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires on January 19, Messi's first club match in Argentina.
Messi's last game there was his farewell for Argentina on October 6, his 208th cap, scoring his 126th international goal.
Miami expects Casemiro, Rodrigo De Paul, Luis Suarez, Nicolas Otamendi and Thiago Almada to travel; the 2027 MLS opener is at FC Cincinnati on February 19.
background: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina and left Barcelona for PSG in 2021 before joining Inter Miami in 2023.

headline: San Jose Earthquakes sold to Alden Global Capital's Heath Freeman for $625 million
facts: Enterprise value is $625 million, per Sportico; the sale includes PayPal Park.
Seller John Fisher has owned the club since 2007; MLS's board approved the transfer unanimously.
The Quakes reached the playoffs only four times in the previous 11 seasons and host Houston in Game 1 of Round 1 on Nov. 24.
background: Freeman co-founded Alden Global Capital, a hedge fund known for buying and cutting costs at newspaper chains; John Fisher also owns the Oakland A's.

headline: Messi up for record third straight MVP; Cavan Sullivan, 17, youngest ever finalist
facts: Messi is an MVP finalist after winning in 2024 and 2025; a third would make him the first three-time winner, since only Preki has won twice.
Cavan Sullivan, 17, is the youngest MVP finalist in league history and the youngest scorer in USMNT history after scoring against Mexico last month.
Other finalists: Houston's Guilherme (16 goals, 10 assists), Cincinnati's Evander and Nashville's Hany Mukhtar; Griezmann is a Newcomer of the Year finalist.
background: Preki won MLS MVP in 1997 and 2003, which was the only multi-time MVP record until Messi's run.

headline: Ex-San Diego FC forward Cedric Bakambu files housing discrimination lawsuit
facts: Bakambu and his wife filed a federal suit in San Diego alleging they were denied rental homes because of their five children.
They name two property owners, a real estate firm and two agents; neither MLS nor San Diego FC is a defendant.
On Nov. 6 Bakambu announced on Instagram he would no longer play for San Diego FC; they seek unspecified damages.
background: Bakambu is a former DR Congo international who also played in Spain, France and China before joining San Diego FC.
footage_terms: Cedric Bakambu San Diego FC goal

headline: Messi's takeover of fifth-tier UE Cornella: followers up to 1 million, results poor
facts: Messi took over UE Cornella, a semi-pro Spanish fifth-tier side, in April 2026; the club's social following grew from about 35,000 to over one million.
Adidas and MyInvestor joined as sponsors, but the team had won only two of its first ten league games.
Messi also agreed to buy second-division Eldense; that deal awaits approval and would force the clubs into separate competitions.
background: The Wrexham comparison refers to Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney's takeover of the Welsh club, which rose through English leagues.

headline: CF Montreal owner Joey Saputo puts club up for sale after 30+ years
facts: The Saputo family said it will start selling the club it has owned since the Impact's founding in 1992; it prefers a local buyer but would accept a relocation offer if none emerges.
CF Montreal finished last in the East with 26 points and six wins in 34 games.
The club fired coach Marco Donadel in April, the 11th manager in 14 seasons.
background: The Montreal Impact started in 1992 in lower leagues and joined MLS in 2012.

headline: Sporting Kansas City fire coach Raphael Wicky after one season
facts: Wicky was fired after one season; the club ended last in the West with 26 points, the second-fewest in club history.
The firing means the club will have its fourth coach since March 2025.
Wicky replaced longtime coach Peter Vermes and interim Kerry Zavagnin; he previously coached Young Boys and Chicago Fire.
background: Peter Vermes was Sporting KC's long-time coach and the club's last coach before Wicky.
footage_terms: Raphael Wicky Sporting KC press conference

headline: Messi becomes first back-to-back MLS Golden Boot winner with 26 goals
facts: Messi scored 26 goals and added 17 assists in 31 games; four goals clear of FC Dallas's Petar Musa.
He is the first player to win the Golden Boot in consecutive seasons, after 29 goals in 2025.
He did not score in a 3-3 final-day draw with Charlotte, which put Miami second in the East.
background: Messi joined Inter Miami in 2023 and won MLS Cup with them in 2025.

headline: Ronaldo retires from Portugal duty after row with coach Jorge Jesus
facts: Ronaldo, 41, announced he has played his last game for Portugal, leaving with a men's record 146 international goals.
The trigger was a row with coach Jorge Jesus: Ronaldo was an unused sub against Norway in September and accused Jesus of breaking two promises; he then walked out of camp before the Denmark match.
He apologized to teammates for leaving and said the federation should decide his punishment; ESPN lists a long history of past clashes with managers.
background: Ronaldo led Portugal to Euro 2016 and past rows included walking off against Sunderland in 2008 and refusing to come on against Tottenham in 2022.

headline: Lewandowski's Chicago jersey outsells Messi's since he arrived in MLS
facts: Lewandowski's Chicago Fire jersey has been the top seller since he joined in June, outselling Messi's Inter Miami shirt.
Messi still finished first for the full year, his fourth straight season at the top; Son was second, Muller third, Lewandowski fourth.
Lewandowski signed on June 29 and debuted on July 22; through 18 games he had seven goals and five assists.
background: Lewandowski is a long-time elite striker who won multiple Bundesliga top-scorer awards with Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund.

headline: AFC postpones 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia over regional security
facts: The tournament planned for Jan 7 to Feb 5, 2027 is moved to Dec 23, 2027 to Jan 21, 2028, pending FIFA approval.
The AFC cited exceptional circumstances in the region, including a conflict with Houthi rebels that reportedly hit sites such as Riyadh's airport.
Weeks earlier AFC president Sheikh Salman said preparations were on track; Riyadh was due to host 30 of 51 matches.
background: Saudi Arabia is also preparing to host the 2034 World Cup and has invested heavily in football through its Pro League.

headline: Ronaldo left out of Al Nassr's ACL squad amid Saudi security concerns
facts: Ronaldo did not travel for Al Nassr's AFC Champions League match, a 6-2 win over Pakhtakor in Tashkent.
Coach Ange Postecoglou said he rested Ronaldo, Kingsley Coman and Mohamed Simakan due to match load and travel.
ESPN links the continental disruption to security worries: a previous home game was delayed after reports of Houthi missile attacks and another was postponed when an opponent declined to travel.
background: Postecoglou previously coached Tottenham and Celtic; Ronaldo has played for Al Nassr since 2022.

headline: AC Milan owner Gerry Cardinale eyes Al Nassr takeover, with Ronaldo as possible part-owner
facts: RedBird Capital is reportedly looking at taking over Al Nassr from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund; Cardinale told Gazzetta the talks are at an early stage.
Under the proposed plan Ronaldo, 41, could become a part-owner; his contract runs to June 2027.
RedBird owns 85% of Toulouse and bought AC Milan in 2022; Cardinale is weighing multi-club ownership.
background: Al Nassr is one of four Saudi clubs owned by PIF, which took over the clubs in 2023.

headline: Ronaldo's 982nd goal: Saudi league credits him, Opta calls it an own goal
facts: Al Nassr won 3-1 against Al Faisaly; Ronaldo headed Joao Felix's free kick but it deflected off defender Andrei Girotto into the net in the 49th minute.
The Saudi Pro League credited Ronaldo, but ESPN's stats provider Opta classed it an own goal.
The goal came days after Portugal suspended him for 30 days over his camp walkout.
background: Ronaldo has been chasing 1,000 career goals; he scored his 900th in 2024.
footage_terms: Ronaldo header Felix free kick Girotto

headline: Ronaldo hat trick in 15 minutes lifts Al Nassr to 5-3 over Al Kholood, tally 985
facts: Al Nassr beat Al Kholood 5-3 in the Saudi Pro League; the score was 2-2 when Ronaldo scored in the 66th, 72nd and 81st minutes.
The three goals came in about 15 minutes and took his career tally to 985, 15 short of 1,000, if the disputed header stays his.
The match was played on a Thursday.
background: Ronaldo has hinted that this season could be his last before retirement and his Al Nassr deal expires in June 2027.

headline: Ronaldo misses penalty on return from Portugal suspension as Al Nassr beat Neom 1-0
facts: Ronaldo sent a stoppage-time first-half penalty wide; Joao Felix scored the only goal after the hour mark.
The Portuguese federation suspended him for 30 days and fined him 255 euros for leaving camp before the Denmark match.
The federation said his admission and clean record reduced the punishment.
background: Ronaldo has taken penalties for club and country for two decades, with Portugal and Al Nassr.
footage_terms: Ronaldo penalty miss Al Nassr Neom

headline: Ronaldo starts filming his first TV series 'Day 1s' with Matthew Vaughn
facts: Ronaldo said on Instagram that filming has begun on 'Day 1s', a football drama made with Matthew Vaughn's UR Marv Studios.
He plays himself and is an executive producer; Damian Lewis plays a British football agent and rapper Dave is in the cast.
Thierry Henry appears as himself; the news comes just after Ronaldo's Portugal retirement.
background: Vaughn directed the Kingsman films; Ronaldo has built a large business empire outside football.

headline: England striker Ivan Toney fails to move assault trial away from Euro 2028
facts: A judge declined a defense request to move Toney's assault trial, set for June 12, 2028, three days into Euro 2028.
Toney, 30, denies assault occasioning actual bodily harm over an alleged nightclub incident on Dec. 6; police charged him in late July.
The defense may reapply if he is named in the England squad; he has 10 caps and played at this summer's World Cup.
background: Toney moved from Brentford to Saudi club Al-Ahli in 2025 and was banned for betting breaches in 2023.

headline: Riyad Mahrez leaves Saudi Arabia for Qatari side Al Shamal as a free agent
facts: Mahrez, 35, signed for Al Shamal, currently fifth in the Qatar Stars League, after leaving Al Ahli in July following three years there.
He had three goals or assists in four games for Algeria at this summer's World Cup.
He won the AFC Champions League Elite with Al Ahli in 2025 and 2026 and five Premier League titles.
background: Mahrez won the 2016 Premier League with Leicester and the 2023 treble with Manchester City.

headline: Chengdu Rongcheng blow 14-point lead, lose Chinese Super League title; coach Aloisi sacked
facts: Chengdu led by 14 points with five rounds left and needed one point, but lost the final matches and the title went to Dalian Yingbo.
Chengdu had the better goal difference, but the league ranks teams on head-to-head first and Dalian won both meetings.
The club dismissed coach John Aloisi and his staff on Tuesday; Aloisi apologized to fans.
background: Aloisi is a former Australia international who scored the penalty that sent Australia to the 2006 World Cup.

headline: Al Ittihad's George Ilenikhena scores on Nigeria debut in AFCON qualifier
facts: The 20-year-old Al Ittihad forward scored a first-half stoppage-time equalizer on his Nigeria debut in a 2-1 win over Madagascar.
Alex Iwobi set up the goal and Moses Usor scored the winner; Victor Osimhen was injured.
Four days later he came off the bench in a 3-0 loss away to Guinea-Bissau.
background: Ilenikhena is a 20-year-old forward who plays his club football for Saudi side Al Ittihad.

headline: Al Hilal's 47-game unbeaten league run ends with 2-0 loss to Neom; Martinelli starts
facts: Al Hilal lost 2-0 at home to Neom, ending a 47-game unbeaten Saudi Pro League run.
It was coach Simone Inzaghi's first league loss at the club and ended a five-win start to the season.
Brazilian Gabriel Martinelli made his first start after joining from Arsenal.
background: Al Hilal are the most successful club in Saudi football and signed Martinelli from Arsenal in a deal reported at 60 million pounds.

headline: Al Taawoun fined and fans banned after Diogo Jota chants aimed at Ruben Neves
facts: The Saudi federation ordered Al Taawoun to play two home games behind closed doors and fined it 100,000 riyals after fans chanted Jota's name during a 6-0 loss to Al Hilal.
The ruling cannot be appealed; Ronaldo called for lifetime stadium bans for those involved.
Ruben Neves, a close friend of Jota, reacted sarcastically to the chants.
background: Jota, the Liverpool and Portugal forward, died in a car crash in Spain in July 2025; Neves played with him for Wolves.
